title: Ondo Asks SEC to Adapt Transfer-Agent Rules for Onchain Securities
why_it_matters: Transfer-agent rules determine how tokenized positions connect to authoritative ownership records, so the final framework could shape interoperability, compliance costs and public-blockchain participation.
caption:
RWA WIRE // REGULATION

Ondo Asks SEC to Adapt Transfer-Agent Rules for Onchain Securities

Ondo urged the SEC to preserve direct and intermediated holding routes, recognize public-blockchain records and reduce repeated reviews for routine tokenized-security transfers.
